bioconductor.name: dandelionR
bioconductor.summary: Single-cell Immune Repertoire Trajectory Analysis in R
bioconductor.description: dandelionR is an R package for performing single-cell immune repertoire trajectory analysis, based on the original python implementation. It provides the necessary functions to interface with scRepertoire and a custom implementation of an absorbing Markov chain for pseudotime inference, inspired by the Palantir Python package.
bioconductor.author: Jiawei Yu [aut] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0009-0005-9170-7881>), Nicholas Borcherding [aut] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1427-6342>), Kelvin Tuong [aut, cre] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6735-6808>)
